dimensions.evidence: PASSED. Independently recomputed: expression (1-0.15*z)*(140-a)*w/(K*sCr) has dimension 1*M/(T*M*L^-3)=L^3*T^-1, matching output creatinine_clearance (m^3/s). K derivation verified: sCr[mg/dL]=100*sCr[kg/m^3] and 1 mL/min=1e-6/60 m^3/s, so K=72*100*60*1e6=432000000000 s (confirmed in Python). The r3 divisor-as-input reformulation resolves the staging failure: no bare dimensional literal remains; guards use K>0 only, avoiding dimensionally invalid equality to a seconds literal. Age term (140-a) is a year-index convention exactly as sourced; record labels it '1 (year index)', unit years, which is documented and consistent.
